name: TrustLens AI — Malicious Behaviour & Dark Pattern Guardian
description: Checks webpages in real time for credential-harvesting forms, homoglyphs, ClickFix traps, and manipulative dark patterns via your local TrustLens AI engine.

_permission_comments.storage: Stores extension token, 10-minute origin+path verdict cache, allow-list, paused sites, and per-check toggles in chrome.storage.local and chrome.storage.session.
_permission_comments.tabs: Reads tab URL/incognito status so chrome://, edge://, file://, and incognito tabs are skipped and toolbar icons match the active tab.
_permission_comments.host_permissions: Restricted strictly to http://127.0.0.1:8000/* so the extension never communicates with any third-party server.
